Display Name: SLOOS C&I net tightening, large and middle-market firms
Description: Net percentage of domestic banks tightening standards for C&I loans to large and middle-market firms (Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey)
Direction Convention: Higher = more banks tightening (tighter credit, bearish for equities)
Known Quirks: Bounded, mean-reverting diffusion index; published inside the quarter it is stamped to; a 2019-11 vintage revised the history; real-time vintages from 2010-04
Display Note: Banks tighten lending standards before and during credit crunches.
